mu_name_from: MODEL_WINGS_OF_SPIRITS = MODEL_WING + 3, Data/Item/Wing04.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:1023, `Wing`, 4 + i); OpenMU's Wings of Spirits, 12/3.
why_this_one: The Muse Elf's 2nd level wing, the Chaos Machine's answer to a 1st wing, a Loch's Feather and a Chaos (docs/second-wings.md, 2026-10-04).
profile_note: A model on its own rig worn on the character, as the 1st wings: the monster profile.
worn_note: Worn on slot 7 as the 1st wings are: linked to player bone 47 at (0, 0, 15), its own 8-key flap at PlaySpeed 0.25, 1 while he flies (ZzzCharacter.cpp:15400-15430). docs/second-wings.md.
rig_from: Twenty bones and one action of eight keys, the flap.
sheet_from: Data/Item/NewingEl.OZJ, 128x128, no alpha: a green and teal veined membrane on black, 102 triangles.
additive_from: ItemObjectAttribute's MODEL_WINGS_OF_SPIRITS: BlendMesh 0 (ZzzObject.cpp:5324-5327), its one mesh added, the black adding nothing -- as the Wings of Elf.
tiled_why: An added sheet needs its own material (Helper01, Wing01).
sheet_materials_from: A membrane drawn as light; added, so the material only names it.

stats.note: The item's own row, OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (0.95d has no 2nd wings).
stats.class_level_note: Its class's second (Muse Elf, Soul Master, Blade Knight): OpenMU's class level 2.
stats.power_note: His blows x(132 + plus)%, what reaches him x(75 - 2 a plus)%, defence + 2 a plus, level + 5 a plus; the option's kind by its PLUS_WING_OP1_TYPE bit; the extras in Held::wing. docs/second-wings.md.
stats.number_note: MU's 12/3; ours 12/13, since this project gave 12/3-6 to the knight's orbs (the user, 2026-10-04: 'Move the wings'). docs/second-wings.md.
